errors.evidence: In the category 'überwiegend negativ', the description states the value for the medium blue bar ('hellblauen') is 'etwa 43 %', but the chart shows this value is approximately 48%.
In the category 'keine Auswirkungen', the description states the value for the light blue bar ('sehr hellblau') is '39 %', but the chart clearly shows this value is above 40%, at approximately 42%.

errors.text_span: und die Kategorien sind alphabetisch sortiert
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims the categories on the vertical axis are sorted alphabetically. They are sorted based on the values of the 'unter 10,45 Euro' group in descending order, as correctly stated earlier in the description. This creates a self-contradiction.

errors.text_span: Die Balken für die Gruppe „unter 10,45 Euro“ sind in allen Kategorien am längsten, außer in der Kategorie „beides in gleichem Maße“
errors.evidence: The description claims the dark blue bars ('unter 10,45 Euro') are the longest in all categories except one. This is incorrect. In the category 'keine Auswirkungen', the dark blue bar is the shortest of the three, with a value of approximately 25%.

errors.text_span: in absteigender Reihenfolge nach der Höhe der Werte in der Gruppe „unter 10,45 Euro“
errors.evidence: While this statement about the sorting order is correct, it is repeated later in the text ('und die Kategorien sind alphabetisch sortiert, wobei die Kategorie mit den höchsten Werten („überwiegend negativ“) oben platziert ist'). The first, more detailed mention, followed by a contradictory and simpler one later, makes the description repetitive and confusing.
